dict.string: Take progress photos for your fitness journal.
Choose progress photos to save in your fitness journal.

Choose health readings to share with your Setcraft account: steps, active calories, workouts, sleep. Optional weight and body fat help track Body progress. Readings are uploaded to Setcraft to show your daily activity and progress.
Setcraft logs completed workouts, active calories, and fitness sessions to Apple Health.
Phone motion gently animates the water illustration while it is visible. Motion readings stay on your phone.
